# The Royal Wedding Photography
> Luxury Wedding Storytellers & Multicam 4K Cinematography Studio based in Dhanbad, Jharkhand, India.

The Royal Wedding Photography is Dhanbad's leading luxury wedding photography studio founded by Director Naresh Kumar. We document royal Indian weddings, candid moments, sacred rituals, 4K multicam cinema, 12x36 handcrafted lay-flat panoramic albums, and AI-powered smart facial recognition client photo delivery across Jharkhand, Bihar, West Bengal, and Pan-India.

## Core Services & Disciplines
1. Candid & Traditional Wedding Photography: Full-day sacred ritual documentation, emotional vidaai, varmala, and family heirloom portraits.
2. Pre-Wedding Concept Shoots: Scenic cinematic shoots at Maithon Dam, Topchanchi Lake, Parasnath Hills, and heritage resorts.
3. 4K Multicam Wedding Cinematography: Cinematic wedding teasers, 60fps slow-motion sequences, and full documentary feature films using Sony FX3 cinema line cameras and DJI Ronin gimbals.
4. Handcrafted 12x36 Panoramic Albums: Lay-flat flushmount albums on Fuji Crystal Archive paper with UV thermal lamination and velvet/leatherette covers.
5. AI Smart Facial Recognition Photo Delivery: Private client galleries where guests scan a selfie to find all their photos instantly.
6. Destination Wedding Photography: Full-crew coverage across Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Patna, Gaya, Kolkata, Purulia, Asansol, Varanasi, and destination venues pan-India.
